name: How long does it take to fix a clogged kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a clogged kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to fix a clogged kitchen sink can vary greatly depending on the cause and severity of the blockage. Simple clogs, easily cleared with a snake or auger, might take less than an hour. More complex issues, such as deep main line blockages or those requiring extensive troubleshooting, camera inspections, or hydro-jetting, could take several hours. Our plumbers will assess the situation upon arrival and provide an estimated timeframe for repair.
